CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mqtt_client_profiles (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  brokerUrl VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
  port INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1883,
  protocol ENUM('mqtt', 'mqtts', 'ws', 'wss') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'mqtt',
  username VARCHAR(255),
  password VARCHAR(255),
  clientIdPrefix VARCHAR(100),
  useTls BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  tlsCertPath TEXT,
  tlsKeyPath TEXT,
  tlsCaPath TEXT,
  rejectUnauthorized BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  keepAlive INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 60,
  connectTimeout INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 30000,
  reconnectPeriod INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 5000,
  cleanSession BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  defaultQos ENUM('0', '1', '2') NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  subscribeTopics JSON,
  publishTopics JSON,
  messageRetain BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  isDefault BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  isActive BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  createdBy INT,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX idx_mqtt_profiles_name (name),
  INDEX idx_mqtt_profiles_active (isActive),
  INDEX idx_mqtt_profiles_default (isDefault)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mqtt_profile_assignments (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  profileId INT NOT NULL,
  targetType ENUM('machine', 'station', 'factory') NOT NULL,
  targetId INT NOT NULL,
  overrideSettings JSON,
  isActive BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  assignedBy INT,
  assignedAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX idx_mqtt_assignments_profile (profileId),
  INDEX idx_mqtt_assignments_target (targetType, targetId)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mqtt_connection_logs (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  profileId INT,
  assignmentId INT,
  clientId VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  brokerUrl VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
  eventType ENUM('connect', 'disconnect', 'error', 'reconnect') NOT NULL,
  eventMessage TEXT,
  errorCode VARCHAR(50),
  ipAddress VARCHAR(45),
  userAgent TEXT,
  timestamp TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX idx_mqtt_logs_profile (profileId),
  INDEX idx_mqtt_logs_client (clientId),
  INDEX idx_mqtt_logs_event (eventType),
  INDEX idx_mqtt_logs_timestamp (timestamp)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mqtt_topic_templates (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  deviceType ENUM('avi', 'aoi', 'spi', 'other') NOT NULL,
  inspectionResultTopic VARCHAR(500),
  ngAlertTopic VARCHAR(500),
  statusTopic VARCHAR(500),
  commandTopic VARCHAR(500),
  heartbeatTopic VARCHAR(500),
  messageFormat ENUM('json', 'xml', 'csv', 'binary') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'json',
  sampleMessages JSON,
  isActive BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX idx_mqtt_templates_device (deviceType),
  INDEX idx_mqtt_templates_active (isActive)
);
